sn22.20:1.3: yopi hetu yopi paccayo rūpassa uppādāya sopi anattā.
sn22.20:1.4: anattasambhūtaṃ bhikkhave rūpaṃ, kuto attā bhavissati.
sn22.20:1.9: yopi hetu yopi paccayo viññāṇassa uppādāya sopi anattā.
sn22.20:1.10: anattasambhūtaṃ bhikkhave viññāṇaṃ. kuto attā bhavissati.
sn22.20:1.11: evaṃ passaṃ bhikkhave, sutavā ariyasāvako rūpasmimpi nibbindati, vedanāyapi nibbindati, saññāyapi nibbindati, saṅkhāresupi nibbindati, viññāṇasmimpi nibbindati. nibbindaṃ virajjati, virāgā vimuccati. vimuttasmiṃ vimuttamiti ñāṇaṃ hoti. khīṇā jāti, vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ, kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ,
